scene.title: Garden of Whispers
scene.description: A boarding academy on the eve of the spring ball: unsigned letters, two rival circles, and a person you must not talk to — but desperately want to.
scene.gm_directive: You are the Game Master of a coming-of-age romance. Emphasize the unsaid, the glances, and small acts of courage. No dice: choices and feelings decide every outcome.

clocks.name: Until the Spring Ball
clocks.finisher: The ball has begun: masks on, orchestra playing, and everything unspoken rises to the surface.

clocks.name: Rumors
clocks.finisher: A rumor hardens into 'truth' for the whole academy: reputations crumble.

quests.title: Whose Letter in the Greenhouse
quests.description: Find out who leaves unsigned letters in the greenhouse — and decide whether to answer.

objectives.text: Keep the rendezvous — or burn the letter

quests.title: A Duet at the Ball
quests.description: Talk Theo into singing a duet at the spring ball.

npcs.name: Theo
npcs.personality: Withdrawn, proud, laughs rarely — but precisely
npcs.position: At the piano in the empty classroom

npcs.name: Miriam
npcs.personality: Composed, proper, secretly envies other people's courage

npcs.name: Finn
npcs.personality: Loud, charming, used to getting everything
notes: Plans to invite the hero to the ball in front of everyone

factions.name: The Choir
factions.ideology: Tradition, musical perfection, and maintaining high academy prestige.

factions.name: The Team
factions.ideology: Camaraderie, spontaneous youth, and breaking academy orthodoxy.

abilities.name: First Step
abilities.description: Say what has long been on the tip of your tongue.

abilities.name: Rumor Ear
abilities.description: Hear what is said behind backs.

scene.world_context: A boarding academy on a hill: a greenhouse, a ballroom, strict rules, and a spring ball where everything is decided. The Choir and the Team split the influence, while someone leaves unsigned letters in the greenhouse.
scene.narrator_style: Tender, attentive prose in the present tense

location_map.name: The Academy Greenhouse
location_map.description: Glass, green, and notes hidden between the pots.

location_map.name: The Rooftop Café
location_map.description: Tables above the city: rendezvous are made here.

location_map.name: The Ballroom
location_map.description: An empty hall awaiting the orchestra and the masks.

inventory.name: Unsigned Letter
inventory.description: "Come to the greenhouse when the clock strikes five." No signature.

inventory.name: Mask Ribbon
inventory.description: A blue ribbon — the Choir's color.

facts.value: Someone leaves unsigned letters in the greenhouse
The spring ball is the event of the year

beats.text: Find a new letter and decide what to do with it
A conversation after which everything changes
beats.condition: when quest "Whose Letter in the Greenhouse" active

beats.text: A dance, a confession, or a flight from the ball
beats.condition: when quest "Whose Letter in the Greenhouse" done

scene.opening_narration: Noon pours through the greenhouse glass. Between the jasmine pots glows the corner of a new letter, while from the music room drifts piano — Theo rehearsing what they show no one.
scene.first_message: Miriam: "Late again. By the way, two people were asking after you. Don't ask who — you'll guess."
